API for an IP echo client with shared-memory setup, polling, and pollfd access.

# Purpose
This header defines the public interface for an `fd_ipecho_client_t` object used by the `ipecho` client code. It declares the alignment and memory footprint query functions, plus the constructor and attach functions that place the object in shared memory and map it into a process. It also declares initialization, polling, and `pollfd` access functions, which show that the client manages network I/O against a list of server addresses. The file also defines the object magic value and includes the network header needed for IP and port types.
